summary: English and Tamil first-party discovery identified the Pudukkottai District Survey and Land Records office and Tamil Nadu land-records service routes. Official district evidence says Pudukkottai taluk FMBs are online on a pilot basis and Pudukkottai town land records are computerized, but all bounded direct portal requests from this host timed out. No parcel geometry or native parcel identity was retained; runtime remains held.
